channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: New details: IDF Rabbi permitted Gaza mission, Givati soldiers still refused to board APC
item.description: New details reveal Givati soldiers refused to board an APC with a female paramedic despite the brigade rabbi’s approval, leading the IDF to cancel the urgent mission.

item.title: i24NEWS poll gives 'Amcha Yisrael' party eight seats
item.description: New i24NEWS poll gives Ofer Winter's new 'Amcha Yisrael' party eight seats, shows it bringing right-religious bloc to 59 seats, compared with center-left's 49.

item.title: How draft evaders beat Ben Gurion Airport controls
item.description: Investigation reveals alleged loopholes allowing haredi draft evaders barred from leaving Israel to bypass border controls and board flights abroad.

item.title: Poll bombshell: Likud crashes to 19 seats, Winter fails to break through
item.description: Poll bombshell: Likud crashes to 19 seats, Winter fails to break through

item.title: Who was listening? Malware found on phones of senior Eisenkot staffers
item.description: Malware designed to listen and collect information was reportedly discovered on the phones of two senior staffers at Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar Party campaign.

item.title: Herd belonging to Jewish farm in Binyamin suspected to have been poisoned
item.description: Herd belonging to Jewish farm in Binyamin suspected to have been poisoned

item.title: Yair Golan in Arabic: Succot is a 'dangerous criminal'
item.description: Democrats chairman Yair Golan blames Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for MK Tzvi Succot's actions in Madama, accusing the government of endangering IDF soldiers to preserve its coalition.

item.title: Police crack down on panhandlers endangering drivers at busy Samaria junction
item.description: Police crack down on panhandlers endangering drivers at busy Samaria junction

item.title: Eisenkot: Government under me will not evacuate farms in Area C
item.description: Yashar Party chairman Gadi Eisenkot said in an interview with Channel 13 News that a government under his leadership would not evacuate legally established farms in Area C.

item.title: Waltz challenges Gaza aid narrative: ‘You know who is not starving?’
item.description: UN Security Council hears competing visions for Gaza as Mladenov hails Hamas disarmament agreement and Waltz sharply challenges criticism of US-backed plan.

item.title: Israeli missing as deadly floods devastate Nepal, Tibet
item.description: At least 95 people killed and more than 400 missing or out of contact as massive floods sweep the Himalayan region.

item.title: Lebanese military arrest Syrian national attempting to smuggle weapons across border
item.description: The Lebanese Armed Forces arrested a Syrian national suspected of attempting to smuggle weapons across the border into Lebanon. The weapons seized included RPGs.

item.title: IDF investigation contradicts initial account of PA detention in Binyamin
item.description: IDF investigation finds PA forces unlawfully detained reservist Shlomo Rosenthal at an unauthorized Area C roadblock, contradicting the initial official account.

item.title: Golani Brigade dismantles 400 terror sites in southern Lebanon
item.description: Troops have dismantled more than 400 terror infrastructure sites and located numerous weapons, including anti-tank missiles, surface-to-air missiles, explosive devices, Kalashnikov rifles, and mortars.

item.title: ‘The Torah strengthens the spirit’: IDF Chief’s message to yeshiva students
item.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir shares how his wounded grandfather cried out ‘Shema Yisrael’ in battle, and tells yeshiva students that Torah strengthens the IDF’s spirit.

item.title: Trump: 'Mojtaba Khamenei very seriously wounded, but not dead'
item.description: US President Donald Trump says Iran’s Mojtaba Khamenei suffered serious wounds to the left side of his body but is likely still alive; praises US military and Navy operations and predicts a “very big victory."

item.title: Israeli forces foil stabbing attack in Samaria: Terrorist armed with knife arrested
item.description:
Earlier today (Wednesday), IDF soldiers guided by the Shin Bet apprehended a terrorist in the Ganot Junction area in Samaria after information was received regarding her intention to carry out a stabbing attack.
The terrorist was apprehended while armed with a knife and was transferred to the security forces for further handling. No injuries were reported

item.title: First poll after Ofer Winter enters politics: Six seats, Smotrich out
item.description: First poll since Ofer Winter launched Amacha Yisrael gives his party six seats, while Religious Zionism falls below the threshold and Netanyahu's bloc drops to 49.

item.title: ‘Entire nation is moved’: Netanyahu visits family of Yehuda Katz
item.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu visits the family of Yehuda Katz, the last missing soldier from Sultan Yacoub, after his remains were returned to Israel.

item.title: ‘Brazen mockery’: Justice Amit’s ‘two phones’ remark sparks haredi uproar
item.description: Shas accuses Supreme Court President Isaac Amit of mocking the haredi public after he claimed many kosher phone users also carry a regular smartphone.

item.title: Terrorists threaten MK Tzvi Succot: 'You are the next target'
item.description: AI-generated assassination video shows masked terrorist shooting Tzvi Succot, warning: 'We are waiting for you everywhere.'

item.title: IDF destroys Hamas ambush position meters from Gaza hospital
item.description: Terrorists eliminated as IDF strikes Hamas position near Kamal Adwan Hospital and a school, where weapons were stored and attacks were being planned.

item.title: Israeli court bans auction of Holocaust yellow badge
item.description: In a landmark ruling, a Haifa court prohibits the public sale of Holocaust artifacts, saying they should be preserved for future generations rather than sold to collectors.

item.title: Exclusive: Katz intervenes after Givati soldiers punished
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz vows to address controversy after yeshiva soldiers confined to base for 21 days over refusal to enter APC with female paramedic.

item.title: August surprise: Thunderstorms, heavy rain set to hit Israel
item.description: After weeks of intense summer heat, unusual weather system could bring double-digit rainfall and even break August records in parts of Israel.

item.title: Mansour Abbas sparks political storm with Naqba remarks
item.description: UAL chairman Mansour Abbas says Israel’s Jewish identity is a reality imposed by the Jewish majority, triggering fierce attacks from Smotrich and Ben-Gvir.

item.title: Soldier blasts Bennett over Madma memorial demolition
item.description: A soldier who secured Tzvi Succot’s controversial Madma visit says troops supported the demolition and rejects claims that the tour endangered them.

item.title: “Now I’m calm:" Footage of rescue of Israeli who accidentally entered Ramallah
item.description: A Holon resident mistakenly entered Area A in the Ramallah area and contacted the police emergency hotline. Border Police officers located his vehicle and quickly rescued him unharmed.

item.title: The price of terror stipends: Major raid on homes of released terrorists
item.description: Security forces raided properties belonging to released terrorists who received salaries from the Palestinian Authority, seizing vehicles and tens of thousands of shekels.

item.title: Givati soldiers punished after refusing to ride with female medic
item.description: Three Givati soldiers reportedly refused to board a Namer carrying a female medic, citing rabbinic instructions. All soldiers in their platoon were sentenced to 21 days of confinement.
